about: Decisions 146b and 147a/c: the permission mode a person chooses at launch, or a start_agent names, per agent. The server (apps/server/src/agent/permission.rs) refuses a mode an agent does not offer with permission_mode_unavailable, a start's mode looser than its parent's with permission_mode_wider, and gives a start without one its parent's mode or the nearest stricter one its agent offers (`inherit`). The host (apps/runtime/src/profile.rs, permission_mode) refuses it again and turns an accepted one into exactly `args` (the agent's own launch flag) and `opencode_permission` (keys Storm's OpenCode config layer sets). `default` is the mode that asks: a start omits the field; Claude Code gets `--permission-mode default` (147a: its own default became auto in 2.1.312, and `default` is a spelling every version takes), every other agent nothing. `auto_off` is Claude Code's `permissions.disableAutoMode: "disable"` in Storm's --settings (147c): auto stays out of its Shift+Tab cycle unless the person launched in auto. No bypass or skip-permissions mode exists anywhere. Neither crate depends on the other: this file keeps them on one rule.
